_note: Reference catalogue only — Claude Code does NOT load this file. Active servers are defined in the repo-root .mcp.json AND must be approved in .claude/settings.local.json under `enabledMcpjsonServers`. A server defined in .mcp.json but absent from `enabledMcpjsonServers` is NOT live. `status` below reflects the true end-to-end state.

_activate.1_define: Add the server block to the repo-root .mcp.json (see `command`/`url` below).
_activate.2_enable: Add the server name to `enabledMcpjsonServers` in .claude/settings.local.json.
_activate.3_auth: Export any env vars the server needs (see `env`), then restart Claude Code.
_activate.4_verify: Run `claude mcp list` (or start with `--mcp-debug`) — the server must show as connected.

context7.purpose: Live library docs (Spring Boot, Avro, Kafka, Testcontainers, Resilience4j).

env: GITHUB_TOKEN (repo scope) or OAuth on first connect
github.purpose: Read PRs, issues, CI status. First connect may prompt for auth.

env: code-review-graph CLI on PATH (pip install code-review-graph); else set command to the absolute path of code-review-graph.exe
code-review-graph.purpose: Local knowledge-graph for token-efficient review: blast-radius / impact / test-coverage queries. Backs the review-changes, explore-codebase, refactor-safely, debug-issue skills. Run `code-review-graph build` once per repo to create .code-review-graph/.

postgres.enable: Define in root .mcp.json + enabledMcpjsonServers once a PG schema exists.
postgres.purpose: Inspect live schema/indexes before writing migrations.

schema-registry.enable: Define + enable once Schema Registry is deployed.
schema-registry.purpose: Query registered Avro schemas / check compatibility.

jira.enable: Define + enable to read ticket descriptions / acceptance criteria.
